variants.name: Clipper (Flamethrower)
variants.description: The Clipper is the smaller sister ship to the popular Southbound Shipyards Argosy. Although not able to carry as much cargo, Clippers are versatile ships that can be used as passenger transports, couriers, or even warships in a pinch, and they come with enough free space to be customized based on an individual captain's needs.

outfits.name: Bunsen Torch
outfits.description: Though heavily debated, the more militant factions in the Senate could push through that licensed captains are allowed to equip their boarding crews with these advanced flamethrowers to break the resistance of enemy crews. However, most people would consider this weapon to be inhumane.

outfits.name: Bunsen_Torch
outfits.description: Right when the war ended, the Bunsen Torch was banned not only in the territories of the Free Worlds, but by the peace agreement also everywhere else. As to be expected, the Pirates didn't care and recognized a business opportunity. 	However, torches bought legally during the war still won't be fined because of exception rules in the corresponding paragraphs.

outfits.name: Bunsen Burner
outfits.description: Being a more sophisticated version of the flamethrower, the Bunsen Burner represents the epitome of Free Worlds creative extravagance. The fuel requirements are so significant that it comes with a pre-installed fuel pod. Nevertheless its usage became feasible only with the introduction of the catalytic ramscoop.

outfits.name: Bunsen Burner Turret
outfits.description: Being a more sophisticated version of the flamethrower, the Bunsen Burner represents the epitome of Free Worlds creative extravagance. The fuel requirements are so significant that it comes with a pre-installed fuel pod. Nevertheless its usage became feasible only with the introduction of the catalytic ramscoop. 	One of the disadvantages of the flamethrower turned out to be that it's only effective when employed on ships which are big enough to be equipped with ramscoops and several fuel pods. As such ships are often slower in turning, the Bunsen Burner comes also in a turret version with high turning rate.
